svg.title: Launcher Hub

div.p: Everything opens in its own about:blank tab. Pick a tab to get started.

label.p: Eaglercraft offline launcher. Download it once, then it loads from your browser cache.
Game hubs and web apps: The Vault, Nocturne and Cup Casino.

div.div: Allow pop-upsLaunches open in a new about:blank tab, so your browser has to allow pop-ups for this page.
Eaglercraft caches itselfThe first launch downloads about 89 MB. After that it starts straight from the cache.
Fresh copyUse Clear Cache on the Minecraft tab to throw the cached copy away and download it again.

div.p: Offline Eaglercraft launcher. Downloads once, then launches from the cache in your browser.

ol.li: Press Download & Launch. The game file is fetched the first time only.
It is saved in your browser (IndexedDB), so the next launch is instant.
The game opens in a new about:blank tab. Allow pop-ups if nothing opens.
Clear Cache removes the saved copy so the next launch downloads a fresh one.

div.p: Game hubs and web apps. Each one opens in its own about:blank tab.
A big library of browser games with an A–Z index, search, pinned and recently played. Each game loads from a CDN when you click it.
The Nocturne web app. It starts with a short ad notice that you can dismiss with OK.
Your private play-money sandbox: originals, slots, table games and sports. No real money involved.
